arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for detailing your situation—I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused. We understand how disruptive it is to get signed out unexpectedly, especially across multiple devices, and I want to provide a clear answer now.

Based on our customer support documentation, there have been no recently announced changes to our sign-in session policy for Pro users. Cursor does not intentionally sign you out on one device when you sign in on another if you use the same Google SSO account. Persistent sign-in should work across your devices, as it has for you for the past year.

If you are suddenly being signed out on one machine each time you sign in on another, this is not expected—there are no new policies that would explain this behavior. It may be a bug or a rare account/session issue that needs investigation on our side.

Next steps:
- Please try signing in from an incognito/private window and see if the behavior changes.
- Check if any new browser extensions or antivirus settings could be interfering with session cookies.
- If this continues, please reply with any recent changes to your security settings, browsers, or devices.

Because your situation may need a deeper, account-level investigation, I’m flagging this for our human support engineers as well. They may follow up directly via email.

Again, I apologize for the disruption. We appreciate your loyalty as a Pro customer and will treat this as a high-priority ticket until resolved.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won’t download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for writing in about your March invoice PDF. I understand how important it is to get these documents for expenses. Based on our current documentation, if the download button for your invoice is spinning and never completes, the most likely causes are browser or extension-related issues.

Here are some steps you can try:
1. Try downloading your invoice from an incognito/private browser window.
2. Ensure that cookies for `billing.cursor.com` are allowed in your browser settings.
3. Disable browser extensions (such as ad blockers or privacy tools) temporarily and attempt the download again.
4. If possible, try a different browser or device to see if the outcome changes.

If none of these steps resolve the issue, please reply with any error messages you see, and we’ll escalate to a human support engineer if needed. You will not lose access to your invoice, and we’ll make sure you get what you need for your records.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion regarding a keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit—feedback like yours helps us improve Cursor for everyone.

At this time, the only documented way to quickly access inline edit is using the command palette (cmd-K), then selecting the desired item. There is not currently a dedicated keyboard shortcut for inline edit, but I’ve logged your feature request for our product team to review. 

If a shortcut for this action is added in the future, we will document it in the release notes and support articles. For now, cmd-K or the mouse are the available options.

Thank you again for using Cursor and sharing your feedback!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support
